decisions.reason: As the flagship product shown on the home page and central to the announced direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal highly unlikely.
Its dedicated product page and visible commitment justify continued investment, so the firm is unlikely to drop it.
Although only mentioned on the website, its role in the integration direction and accumulated investment support persistence.
Close to the established offer with limited public visibility, it has lower escalation pull but still enough sunk cost and fit to retain it.
